correctness.rationale: The polygon has exactly seven lattice points and normalized area seven. Every candidate smooth toric resolution is a seven-triangle unimodular coherent subdivision; seventeen unit triangles are exhaustively generated. Pairwise-compatible exact coverings give ten phases. All ten integer height assignments certify strict convexity over all eight interior edges. Exact two-triangle swaps give thirteen adjacency edges; all-pairs BFS gives diameter five and a unique antipodal pair. Universal finite enumeration is established from geometric completeness, not extrapolated from sample experiments.

value.rationale: The canonical local model of a newly constructed nonsmoothable Calabi--Yau threefold is a natural and complete finite moduli problem: all marked smooth projective crepant toric resolutions and their elementary flop connections. Proving all ten phases coherent, with a connected thirteen-wall network and unique five-flop diameter pair, supplies actionable birational-geometric structure beyond the existing deformation-theoretic construction. No arbitrary slice or routine special-case substitution is involved.
